We offer free returns within 30 days of delivery — no questions asked. Items must be unworn with tags attached. Refunds are processed within 3 business days of the parcel reaching our warehouse.
Yes. Choose an instant exchange at checkout and we will ship the new size before we receive your return, subject to availability. Size exchanges are always free, including return postage.

Our fits are true to size with a modern, slightly relaxed cut. Each product page includes a detailed size guide with garment measurements. If you are between sizes, we generally recommend sizing down for tailoring and up for knitwear.

We produce in small runs across family-run workshops in Portugal, Italy and India — each audited annually for fair wages and working conditions. Our denim is woven in Kaihara, Japan; our silk is stone-washed in Como.

Every Atelier Noir piece carries a 10-year repair guarantee. Send us the garment with a note describing the issue and we will mend, reline or re-cut it free of charge — you only pay return postage once.

Absolutely. All transactions are encrypted end-to-end and processed by PCI-DSS compliant providers. We accept all major cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. We never store card details on our servers.
